name: judgement-os
description: A second opinion for your Claude Code skills, only when they need one. Skills decide with a plain rule; at the few marked decisions where the answer depends on you, two judges weigh in, you settle what they both disagree on, and every call is logged. Plus a daily loop, house-style HTML pages, one front door for making things, 28 thinking tools, a send gate, hard-rule hooks and real dice.
